sources.snippet: A foundation model for mobiles, wearables, robots, smart home, automotive and microcontrollers. The whole model is a single 8-29 MB file, and we trade general chat capacity to beat models 10x its size on mobile tool calls and match 2-3x bigger models on extraction.
